subject: planner: parallel apply keep order (#66714)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent for planner/executor behavior: PhysicalApply gains `KeepOrder` wired into executor; planner no longer rejects sort properties for Apply; executor preserves outer-row order in parallel mode via per-row `seq` + `reorderWorker` with bounded buffering (`outerPaceCh`). No remaining Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, consistency, compatibility, or concurrency issues identified in this commit; later upstream history shows follow-up improvements but no outstanding High/Blocker correctness issue attributable to this change.
